title: Inference for Causal Path-Specific Effects in Longitudinal Studies with Repeated Treatments and Multiple Mediators
abstract: arXiv:2610.34349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In longitudinal studies, repeated treatments may be followed by different sequences of mediators and time-varying covariates. We develop semiparametric inference for path-specific effects in this setting, allowing the number, type, and ordering of intermediate variables to vary across treatment occasions. Under consistency, positivity, edge consistency, and the cross-world restrictions of a nonparametric structural equation model with independent errors, path-specific means are identified by the edge g-formula. We derive two parameterizations of the efficient influence function of the identifying functional. The first follows the observed-data factorization and uses conditional intermediate-variable densities. translated_title: 具有重复处理与多个中介变量的纵向研究中因果路径特定效应的推断
translated_abstract: 在纵向研究中，重复施加的处理之后可能伴随不同的中介变量和时变协变量序列。我们在这一设定下发展了路径特定效应的半参数推断方法，允许中间变量的数量、类型和排序在不同的处理时点上有所变化。在一致性、正性、边一致性以及具有独立误差的非参数结构方程模型的跨世界约束条件下，路径特定均值可通过边g-公式得到识别。我们推导了识别泛函的有效影响函数的两种参数化形式：第一种遵循观测数据的因子分解，使用条件中间变量密度；第二种利用序贯回归替代相应的积分运算，并通过贝叶斯法则借助处理历史回归来表达密度比，从而避免了对中间变量密度的直接估计。
tldr: 该论文针对重复处理后中介变量与时变协变量序列可变的纵向研究，发展了路径特定因果效应的半参数推断方法，通过边g-公式识别效应，并给出有效影响函数的两种参数化形式，其中基于序贯回归的方法避免了对中间变量密度的直接估计。
en_tdlr: This paper develops semiparametric inference for path-specific causal effects in longitudinal studies with repeated treatments where the number, type, and ordering of intermediate variables may vary across treatment occasions, identifying these effects via the edge g-formula and providing two parameterizations of the efficient influence function, one of which avoids direct estimation of intermediate-variable densities through sequential regressions.
